summary: Operator site + its ResNexus engine (July 2027 weeknight): fees -> $61.30-72.73 (30-amp to premium sites; non-refundable 10% less), full hookups with 30/50 amp, sites 58 -> 28 (operator's site list A-01..B-09, 30-72 ft), max 72 ft, wifi and RV laundry, online booking with deposit terms; military cleared (directory only). Season not stated anywhere, left absent. Gate: $61.30 > US$50, no gateway within 40 km -> flag. Note: dropped the site/amp/season/RV Life restatements.
flags: PRICE GATE FAIL: July 2027 weeknight $61.30/night for the cheapest (30-amp) RV site on the operator's engine; even the non-refundable rate ($55.17) is over US$50. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Denver 111 km); no family stays. The stored ~$52-63 came from RV Life. Candidate drop under the price-gate rule.

Long-stay check: weekly and monthly rates exist ('Extended stays may require additional approval'), and every site is named 'Seasonal RV', but all 28 are sold for single nights on the engine at posted prices, so it is not long-stay in character. 'Seasonal' is unexplained (no season dates are stated anywhere).
Not a casino lot: an independent historic hotel + RV park (owned since 2014 by the Duffy/Leonard/Diley family per the About page), under a mile from the casino district.
Site count: the operator lists 28 RV sites; the stored 58 (from old note prose) is unsupported.
